item.description:
macci 2.7.3

  • Bring your own AI provider & model — OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Gemini, or the built-in default (Settings → AI Model).
  • On-screen annotations: the assistant can draw arrows, boxes and circles to point things out.
  • Guided walk-throughs: step-by-step arrows to the next control in any app.
  • Autonomous agent: hand it a whole task; a floating card shows progress and asks before anything is sent, deleted or paid.
  • Logbook connectors: push entries and AI summaries to Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion or a custom webhook.
  • MCP connectors: attach Model Context Protocol servers so the agent can call their tools.
  • Skills: write plain-language instructions for your recurring tasks (Settings → Skills).
